description: The Org’s MCP allows you to work inside your account on The Org to accelerate your lead generation or job discovery process. Search and filter for people and jobs using our network of more than 2 million org charts. Leverage advanced filters available nowhere else like level, manager, and reports and understand how people and jobs fit into the organization. Designed for speed and control: ChatGPT can pull only what you ask for, respect your account boundaries, and produce outputs that are ready to review, personalize, and use.

defaultPrompt: Who are the VPs of Engineering at Notion, who do they report to?
Find open Product Manager jobs at OpenAI
